proposals.evidence: User adjudication fixes the fly lexical parent as uḍḍayate 1697-2, with *uddayati 1697-5 retained as the alternative. This complete inchoative expression consists of fly (infinitive/participle) plus lag-/begin. Turner lagyati explicitly includes western Pahari lagṇū, Nepali lāgnu and Hindi lagnā in the begin sense. No extra remain or copula is added to the recorded expression.
